verdict.line: You lose this when you throw Q or E into a Gnar with both his Q and E up and get kited for free; you win it when you force the fight the instant his Boomerang Throw and Hop are both on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Aatrox carries both the lane and solo-kill edge here (50.7% over 2154 games) because Mini Gnar's kite tools are cooldown-gated — Q (Boomerang Throw, 16-10s) and E (Hop, 22-12s) — and he has zero hard CC until he caps Rage into Mega Gnar. The whole lane is about timing your all-ins to land when those two cooldowns are actually down, because committing Q or E into a Gnar who still has his slow and his hop is exactly how you get kited.

theirWindow.when: Mini Gnar with Q and E both up
theirWindow.what: Do not chase. He slows you with Boomerang Throw then hops away with E (Hop) and resets neutral — this is the exact kite OP.GG flags against your Q/E commitments. Back off and let his cooldowns burn instead.

yourWindow.when: his Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately. Land W (Infernal Chains) to catch him in the impact zone, let your passive (Deathbringer Stance) proc for the healing auto, then E (Umbral Dash) onto him — he has no stun and no gap-close until Mega Gnar, so a committed trade here is yours to win.

start.why: Run this over Doran's Blade (51% over 1730 games vs 49.2% over 750) — the regen and damage block directly counter the Q poke chip you'll eat before you can close distance.

boots.why: 81.8% pick at 50.9% WR; flat damage reduction on Gnar's hyper-charged autos (from his W) matters more than the magic resist Mercury's Treads offer here.

core.why: The shield proc punishes Gnar whenever he commits to an all-in with Mega Gnar's W stun, blunting the burst that follows it.
Highest-winrate path with Eclipse (56.6% over 76 games) — ability haste shortens your Q/W/E cycle so you're threatening again before his cooldowns reset.
Converts the poke damage you take while closing distance into a DoT you can heal through, smoothing the exact chip-damage pattern Gnar relies on.

runes.keystoneWhy: Both top rune pages on this matchup run Conqueror — the stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the extended trades you're forcing once his Q and E are down, rather than a burst keystone that wants a shorter window.

summoners.why: Dominant pick at 66.7% (50.2% WR) — Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into real kills when you catch him mid-combo with no healing to fall back on, and Flash backs up your W (Infernal Chains) engage.

playing.title: Trade only on his cooldowns
playing.detail: Only commit Q (The Darkin Blade, 14-6s CD) or E (Umbral Dash, 9-5s CD) when his Q (Boomerang Throw, 16-10s CD) and E (Hop, 22-12s CD) are both down. Otherwise he slows you and hops away for free.

playing.title: Watch the Rage bar, not just HP
playing.detail: Once Gnar nears max Rage he transforms into Mega Gnar, trading his kite tools for a point-blank stun (W, Wallop) and a wall-stunning ultimate (R, GNAR!). Disengage before he caps Rage, not after he's already transformed.

playing.title: Stack your passive before committing
playing.detail: Let Deathbringer Stance proc an empowered auto — bonus magic damage plus healing off his max HP — before you throw W into a fight. That extra sustain is what flips trades he initiates.

playing.title: Land W right as he hops
playing.detail: W (Infernal Chains) hits the first target and drags them back if they don't clear the impact zone fast. Time it for the moment Gnar's E (Hop) lands so he can't immediately kite off again.

playing.title: Dash in after his Q is thrown, not before
playing.detail: E (Umbral Dash) heals you off damage dealt and closes distance, but dashing in while his Q is still in the air gets you caught by the slow. Wait for the throw, then commit.

playing.title: Respect his ult at later ranks
playing.detail: Gnar's R (GNAR!) cooldown drops to 30s then 0s at ranks 4-5, meaning a near-spammable knockback that stuns anyone it throws into a wall. Avoid fighting him flush against lane walls from the mid-game on.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read on why those numbers come out the way they do.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being kited by Mini Gnar when you use [Q][E] in lane. Use your lane sustain to fight whenever your skills come off cooldown to deal burst damage in order to gain lane control.
